definitions.explanation: A local tax levied on individuals based on their income and place of residence. In Japan, it is paid to the prefecture and municipality where one lives.

examples.japanese: {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}は{毎月|まいつき}{給料|きゅうりょう}から{引|ひ}かれる。
examples.english: Resident tax is deducted from my salary every month.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すと{住民税|じゅうみんぜい}の{金額|きんがく}が{変|か}わることがある。
examples.english: When you move, the amount of resident tax can change.

examples.japanese: {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}は{前年|ぜんねん}の{所得|しょとく}に{基|もと}づいて{計算|けいさん}されるので、{退職|たいしょく}した{翌年|よくねん}も{支払|しはら}いが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Since resident tax is calculated based on the previous year's income, you still need to pay it the year after you quit your job.

notes:
USAGE:
An important tax for anyone living and working in Japan. Unlike {所得税|しょとくぜい} (income tax), which is a national tax, {住民税|じゅうみんぜい} goes to local governments. It is calculated based on the previous year's income, which means new graduates or new residents may not pay it in their first year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}を{納|おさ}める (to pay resident tax)
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}の{申告|しんこく} (resident tax declaration)
- {住民税|じゅうみんぜい}{非課税|ひかぜい} (exempt from resident tax)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所得税|しょとくぜい}: income tax — a national tax on income
- {固定資産税|こていしさんぜい}: property tax — levied on real estate
